th: แคลเซียมในเลือดต่ำ

sections.html:
• Hypocalcemia — Total Corrected Serum Calcium < 2.10 mmol/L
    • Low phosphate (เส้นประ → หน้า 148) Low Phosphate

      เส้นประในเล่ม — รายละเอียดอยู่หน้า 148 (Low Phosphate)

    • High phosphate High Phosphate
      • Normal creatinine · low/normal PTH Low/Normal PTH — Normal Creatinine
        • Hypoparathyroidism (e.g. Acquired, Autoimmune, Idiopathic, Congenital, Infiltrative)
        • Activating Mutation in Calcium Sensing Receptor (CaSR)
        • Hypomagnesemia
      • Normal creatinine · high PTH High PTH — Normal Creatinine
        • PTH Resistance (Pseudo-hypoparathyroidism)
        • Calcium Complexing (Citrate Infusion, Pancreatitis)
      • High creatinine · low PTH Low PTH — High Creatinine
        • Hypoparathyroidism with Chronic Kidney Disease
      • High creatinine · high PTH High PTH — High Creatinine
        • Secondary Hyperparathyroidism
        • Rhabdomyolysis
        • Phosphate Poisoning

Corrected total serum calcium concentration (mmol/L) = measured total serum calcium concentration (mmol/L) + 0.02[40 g/L – albumin(g/L)]

sections.h: Hypocalcemia — High / Low PTH (หน้า 149)
sections.html:
• Hypocalcemia — Total Corrected Serum Calcium < 2.10 mmol/L
    • Low PTH Low PTH — Hypoparathyroidism
      • Congenital (pediatric) Congenital (Pediatric)
        • Ca-S-R
        • DiGeorge
      • Acquired Acquired
        • Post-operative neck
        • Radiation
        • Infiltrative disease
        • Autoimmune polyendocrinopathy
        • Hypomagnesemia
    • High PTH High PTH
      • 25-OH D very low 25-OH D very low
        • Malabsorption
        • Short gut
        • Gastric bypass
        • Liver disease
        • Increased Vit-D degradation (eg. anti-convulsants)
      • 25-OH D not very low 25-OH D not very low
        • Chronic Renal Failure
        • Severe hyperphosphatemia (eg. Tumor lysis syndrome, rhabdomyolysis, oral phosphate abuse/laxatives)

Corrected total serum calcium concentration (mmol/L) = measured total serum calcium concentration (mmol/L) + 0.02[40 g/L – albumin(g/L)]
